missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Счастье' is the neuter nominative, the thing that is hard to find. 'Настоящее' is the agreeing neuter adjective. A reflective model for abstract emotion.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. Neuter 'счастье' has an accusative identical to the nominative, here the direct object of 'ищет'. 'Каждый человек' is the nominative subject. A universal everyday statement.
Strategic focus: Genitive with quantity. 'Счастья' is the genitive governed by 'много'. 'В жизни' is the prepositional location. A natural way to express abundance of an abstract noun.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Счастью' is the dative governed by 'радуются', as 'радоваться' takes the dative. 'Простому' agrees in the neuter dative. Strong emotional vocabulary.
Strategic focus: Genitive of cause. 'От счастья' uses the genitive 'счастья' after 'от' to express the emotional cause of crying. A vivid, very common emotional pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Счастьем' is the instrumental expressing what he lives by. 'Своей семьи' is the genitive of belonging. A heartfelt instrumental model.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О настоящем счастье' uses the prepositional 'счастье' after 'о' to express the topic. 'Настоящем' agrees in the neuter prepositional. A reflective discussion frame.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Счастье' is the nominative predicate noun after the dash. 'Большое' is the agreeing neuter adjective. A classic definitional sentence with 'это'.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Без счастья' uses the genitive 'счастья' after 'без' to express absence. 'Жизнь' is the nominative subject. A strong contrastive pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive in wishes. 'Счастья' is the genitive governed by 'желаю', which takes the genitive of the thing wished. 'Большого' agrees in the neuter genitive. The standard toast formula.
